NOUGHTVAULT  //  PACKAGING · THE WRAP

The wrap

A furoshiki fold sized to the 90 × 70 mm plate, finishing at roughly 110 × 95 mm — flat enough for the letter tier, and closed by nothing but its own last corner. The absence of a fastening is the design: there is no moment where the customer looks for scissors. Do not close it with a VOID seal — transfer is already unreliable on titanium and will not happen at all on woven cotton, and a seal that visibly fails on the wrapper teaches the customer it is decorative minutes before they use one on the plate.

01 — LAYplate face-down, centred
02 — NEAR CORNERup, and over the plate
03 — SIDES INleft, then right
04 — ROLLto the far corner; tuck
